positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Designing and wire-framing websites and mobile applications.  
Build beautiful websites using HTML CSS JS and JQuery, Foundation 6 and other JavaScript libraries. 
Specialize in responsive web development and Design.
Create flexible layouts with flexbox, Susy and Breakpoints.

Design and prototype websites and mobile applications  in Sketch 3 and Principle. 
Build and customize animations for mobile applications

positions.title: Personal Trainer
positions.description:
Develop tailored fitness plans for clients on behalf of leading health club with over $1.3 million in annual revenue, personally generating more than $100,000 in sales each year.
Work with Branch Manager to implement marketing strategies which significantly increased number of new clients. 
Conduct individual assessments to define optimal health targets pertaining to weight loss, nutrition, muscle mass development and strength-training exercises, targeting interventions to promote progress towards goals.
Lead weekly fitness sessions, incorporating body fat measures and food logs, providing feedback regarding progress.
Process sales transactions for training packages, with prices ranging from $900 up to $3,000, informing clients of benefits of consistent fitness regimens and projected results.
Train and supervise staff, ensuring optimal safety of health club members and appropriate use of fitness equipment.
Conducted over 1,300 individual training sessions, ensuring compliance with state guidelines and NSCA principles.

positions.title: Social Media/ Marketing Co-Director
positions.description:
Developed digital marketing campaigns for clients, fostering partnerships with more than 150 popular fashion brands.  
Increased online presence by up to 800% using Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and Pinterest, reporting to company CEO.
Performed analysis of social media campaigns using industry tools and listening platforms Google Analytics and HubSpot, developing reports summarizing performance metrics for submission to senior management.
Consistently assessed sales and revenue data throughout campaign life-cycles, measuring email open rates, increases in social media followers, audience demographics and viewer location data to evaluate performance.
